# SAMUH

> Organizational and high-performance consulting, in partnership with Sapien Labs. High performance without the cost to people.

SAMUH (samuh.work) works with teams on the conditions they work in. The claim: most teams leak performance through their environment, not their effort. SAMUH finds where a team is leaking, and gives it the practices to close it.

The word is Sanskrit: a group of people who come together for a purpose larger than themselves.

## What SAMUH does

- Works with teams, not only individuals or the whole organization. The team is where people experience their work life, and where capacity is won or lost.
- Reads the team environment with TeamQ, SAMUH's instrument built on Sapien Labs team environment factors. TeamQ is done with a real team; the tool on samuh.work/teamq is a demonstration of how it thinks, not an assessment.
- Measures first: LeadQ for a leader, TeamQ for a team, OrgQ across an organization. Then the 90-day sprint. On the platform it runs Self-guided (the team works through it on its own) or Supported (Self-guided plus calls with SAMUH). Executive Team Sprints are delivered by SAMUH with the leadership team, and start with a conversation.
- Audience: leadership teams in multi-team organizations, team leads, store managers, and founders of fast-growing companies.

## Sapien Labs

Sapien Labs is SAMUH's research partner and the source of the research the site leans on. Its Work Culture and Mental Wellbeing report is the spine of the argument: https://sapienlabs.org/work-culture-and-mental-wellbeing/
